lessons.title: Read the paired difference
lessons.why_this_step: Measure the change on the same units before choosing a Configuration.
how_to_do_it: Check that both Assessments cover the same units.
Find the sign of the paired difference.
lessons.how_to_read: Relate the sign to the direction in which the Metric improves.
pitfalls: Reversing the Comparison sides changes the sign and reverses which side appears to improve.
lessons.question: Which side would you favour if the error fell?
